text:
mia: Heads-up — eu-edge-rack-7 capacity is spiking. Tenant "fastviz" is saturating egress and GPU lanes. Anyone else seeing this?

ops-bot: Alert: Rack eu-edge-7 network egress > 95% for 25s; top tenant fastviz (64% traffic)

sanjay: Confirming. noticed increased pcie stalls and KV cache churn. latency p50 for small chat jobs jumped 3x on nodes 7-12.

olivia: Can you paste the recent pod allocation? thinking it's fractional dedicated slice maybe mis-sized.

mia: paste metrics snippet:

```
rack: eu-edge-7
nodes: 7-12
gpu_util: 78-95%
egress_mb_s: 4200 -> norm 1200
p50_gen_ms: 42 -> 130
top_tenant: fastviz (64% egress, 58% token/sec)
```

henry: fastviz just launched a batch rollout around 10:12 UTC? saw a spike in their queue depth. They were on shared pool, not dedicated.

leila: Risk: if we throttle them with soft-affinity, we reduce their SLA. proposal: carve a small dedicated slice 1xA100 per rack for them during rollout window, or apply egress shaping at the rack-level.

sanjay: prefer shaping + kvcache pinning. Dedicated slice adds cost and fragmentation. Shaping rules:

- per-tenant egress cap: 2 Gbps
- token-per-sec cap: 40k tps
- kvcache reservation: 2 nodes pinned

olivia: how quickly can we push shaping? we have a flow control patch in prod canary.

mia: we can toggle soft-egress-shaper via /ops/shapers in next 2 minutes. want to try capped at 3Gbps first.

henry: +1 to start conservative. also enable preemptible fallback to quantized-2 to reduce GPU time.

leila: also log telemetry for 30m with "noisy-neighbor" tag. need to produce a short postmortem if shaping doesn't stabilize.

ops-bot: Action scheduled: apply_shaper rack=eu-edge-7 tenant=fastviz egress_cap=3Gbps start=4087654345

mia: applying now.

sanjay: saw immediate drop in egress to ~2.9Gbps, p50 back to 55ms. keep monitoring.

olivia: can we get a snapshot of allocation so we can decide whether to carve dedicated slice later? I'll run allocation-export.

henry: allocation-export done — shared pools still 6.8k reserved but 2 nodes show high kvcache churn. sending output to #eng-infra-private.

mia: thanks. if this keeps stable for 10m, I'll close the incident. tagging @oncall.

leila: capture cost delta for the shaping action (we might bill fastviz for emergency shaping if customer-triggered rollout).

ops-bot: Incident closed automatically after 15m of stability. Close ts=4087654385
